episodes.overview: The kids want to dance to some annoying music, but Dad pretends his battery on his phone is flat - until Mum phones him.

episodes.name: Bingo 3000
episodes.overview: Dad has bought a brand new "Bingo 3000" robot, but it's not working properly, so he calls technical support.

episodes.name: Muffin Unboxing
episodes.overview: Stripe films Muffin unboxing a dump truck toy.

episodes.name: Letter
episodes.overview: Nana reads an old story that Bandit wrote from when he was five. The kids find this hilarious as Nana is reading out the words exactly as they are spelt.

episodes.name: Hungry
episodes.overview: Dad is hungry so he pretends to eat Bluey.

episodes.name: Three Pigs
episodes.overview: Dad retells the story of the three little pigs.

episodes.name: Animals
episodes.overview: Mum is playing the animal game on Bingo's back. She pretends Bingo's back is a big field, and various animals walk, jump and dart across it, making Bingo laugh.

episodes.name: Compilation #1
episodes.overview: A collection of minisodes from batch 1.

episodes.name: Tattoo Shop
episodes.overview: Dad visits the 'tattoo shop' where the kids give him some ink. Dad wants skulls & snakes etc, 'cos he has to look really tough. When it comes time to reveal, it's not quite what dad envisaged.

episodes.name: Phoney
episodes.overview: After a big day everyone wants to sit back and listen to some relaxing music except Unicorse, who keeps getting 'Phoney' to change the tune.

episodes.name: Blocks
episodes.overview: Bluey and Bingo have built an enormous tower of blocks and ask if Nana can keep the tower up until they come back. Nana and Bob try to live in their smallish unit without knocking it over.

episodes.name: Government
episodes.overview: Dad is using Bingo's back as a typewriter to type a letter to the government demanding they do something about his errant children.

episodes.name: Drums
episodes.overview: Bingo is in the music shop with Mum when she discovers an electronic drum kit and some headphones.

episodes.name: Browny Bear
episodes.overview: Someone keeps tapping people on the shoulder and vanishing, it's very annoying! Mum enlists Private Investigator, Browny Bear to investigate.

episodes.name: Whirlpool
episodes.overview: The kids make a whirlpool in the paddling pool and then jump into the swirling current.

episodes.name: Compilation #2
episodes.overview: A collection of minisodes from batch 2.

episodes.name: Strong Potion
episodes.overview: Bingo has taken a magic strength potion, so she can lift Dad about with ease.

episodes.name: Robo Bingo
episodes.overview: Mum attempts to get "Robo Bingo" to clean its teeth with very specific instructions.

episodes.name: Butlers
episodes.overview: In Bluey's dreamhouse, Monty, the head butler, is onboarding a new butler. The dreamhouse inventions are all designed to help the ladies of the manor live a life of complete ease.

episodes.name: Where's Bingo?
episodes.overview: Dad just can't find Bingo anywhere and no one can help, but it turns out she's just been there the whole time.

episodes.name: Goldilocks
episodes.overview: A retelling of Goldilocks and the three bears, from the bears point of view.

episodes.name: Alongside
episodes.overview: Bluey and Honey go about their separate days until luck brings them together momentarily.

episodes.name: Compilation #3
